title: SentinelCiEvent
description: Strict schema for HMAC-signed CI/CD stage and gate events ingested by the Sentinel backend.

source.description: Originating script, CI stage, or agent name.

job_id.description: GitLab CI job ID emitting this event (used for idempotency deduplication).

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA (40-character hex) associated with this build or fix.

release_id.description: Optional label. The backend identifies a release by commit_sha (rel-<sha[:12]>) and ignores this field when commit_sha is present.

incident_id.description: Sentinel incident identifier if this event pertains to an ongoing recovery.

artifact_url.description: URL to retained, non-sensitive evidence bundle or test report artifact.

sent_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the event was emitted by CI.

data.description: Event-specific payload. Backend requirements per type (409/422 otherwise): incident.detected needs breached_thresholds[]; rollback.completed needs post_rollback_probe_ok; evidence.collected needs top-level artifact_url + evidence_sha256; flow.started needs flow_session_id; repair.proposed needs mr_iid + fix_sha; regression_proof.verdict PASS needs broken_run + fix_run; integrity_gate.verdict needs verdict (+ findings); deploy/evaluator events should carry traffic_percent, and evaluator.verdict / recovery.verified should carry target, error_rate, p95_ms, sample_size; recovery.verified must come from the evaluator, for the fix SHA, at traffic_percent 100. Values that look like credentials are rejected (SECRET_DETECTED).

post_rollback_probe_ok.description: rollback.completed: required. true -> ROLLED_BACK, false -> ROLLBACK_FAILED.

flow_session_id.description: flow.started: required. Duo workflow/session id; starts the investigation deadline.

reason.description: Human-readable failure reason stored on the attempt for terminal states.

broken_run.description: regression_proof.verdict: required for PASS. Must be outcome=failed, failure_type=AssertionError.

fix_run.description: regression_proof.verdict: required for PASS. Must be outcome=passed.
